summary: Two climbers fell ~60 feet at the Weller Slab climbing area adjacent to Weller Campground on Independence Pass ~9:15 PM; 20+ MRA members plus a West Elk Mountain Rescue member and Aspen Ambulance medics responded. One climber flown by Flight for Life Colorado, the other transported by ambulance.
location: Weller Slab climbing area, adjacent to Weller Campground, Independence Pass
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; West Elk Mountain Rescue; Aspen Ambulance
